notes: Full description: When the 'serde' feature is enabled, DeviationAction, DeviatedFinding, and EvaluationReport all derive Serialize/Deserialize. However Deviation (pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:65), DeviationScope (line 193), and DeviationStore (line 411) do NOT have #[cfg_attr(feature = "serde", derive(serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize))]. This asymmetry means a caller who enables 'serde' to serialize EvaluationReport (which contains DeviatedFinding) cannot serialize the underlying Deviation store itself — there is no way to export or restore the deviation configuration. The module doc comment at line 38-57 describes a use case of attaching deviations to audit packs, which implies serialization of the full deviation store is desirable. Fix: add serde derives to Deviation, DeviationScope, and DeviationStore under the 'serde' feature flag.
title: RUSTY: DeviationStore not serde-serializable despite fields that are
